description: Send a shopping list to a grocer near the cook: into their cart where the store allows it (King Soopers and other Kroger stores, once connected), else one list link, else a search link per item. Use when the cook says "order these", "get it delivered", "send it to my store". No saved store: it asks their ZIP, then lists nearby grocers (choose_store); call again with store and zip, which saves it. A cart grocer first returns cart_preview: tell the cook its say (flagged items and total only), apply their changes as edits, then call with preview_id and confirm: true. Share share_url with the cook (the order is theirs: Befana's order page uses their saved store and sign-in); list_url is the link for the household. Befana never picks a brand. Keep commission_disclosure in parentheses right after the link, once.

confirm.description: true, with preview_id, once the cook said yes to the preview

edits.description: The cook's changes to a preview ("skip the hoisin", "2 salmon"), with preview_id

line.description: The preview line's number or the item's name ("hoisin sauce")

quantity.description: How many to add; 0 takes it out

remove.description: true takes the line out of the cart

list_id.description: Id of a saved list from build_shopping_list or plan_meals

pantry.description: Ingredients the cook already has; they are not ordered

preview.description: A cart grocer previews before adding anything (the default). false adds straight away, only when the cook said they don't need to check

preview_id.description: A cart_preview's id: with edits it updates the preview, with confirm: true it adds exactly those items to the cart

provider.description: Grocer to hand the list to: instacart, walmart, kroger, amazon or search. Omit for the cook's saved store, or Instacart when that store isn't available. An unknown or unavailable grocer returns an error listing the available ones.

remember_store.description: false for a one-off order elsewhere; the saved store stays as it was

store.description: The store the cook picked or named ("Sprouts", "King Soopers"), ideally one from choose_store. Saved as their store unless remember_store is false

units.description: US cups/oz/°F or metric grams/ml/°C. Defaults to the cook's setting.

zip.description: The cook's ZIP code, when they gave it; saved with their store. Never guess it

name: order_groceries

adjusted.description: Defaults this call took instead of failing (#243): an unknown units word, a number out of range, a diet word read as the closest one Befana knows. Mention it when it changes what the cook gets

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

cart_preview.description: A cart grocer's preview (#227): nothing is in the cart yet. Tell the cook its say (flagged lines and the total only), apply their changes with edits, then call again with preview_id and confirm: true. The handoff fields are absent

expires_at.description: ISO time the preview lapses; nothing is added after it

flagged.description: Lines to read out: low-confidence or substituted

lines.description: The whole cart, for when the cook asks to see it

confidence.description: high: every word of the item is in the product's name

flag.description: Why the cook should check this line

line.description: Name a line by this (or its name) in edits

name.description: The item from the cook's list

price_each.description: Shelf price at the cook's store, US dollars; null when the grocer gave none

product.description: The grocer's description of what its search returned, for the cook to check; not a Befana pick, and only shown when the cook asks for the full list

quantity.description: How many go in the cart

not_found.description: List items with no product at this store: they stay on the list, not in the cart

partial.description: true when a line has no price, so the total leaves it out

preview_id.description: Pass back with confirm: true (or edits) within about 30 minutes

removed.description: Items the cook took out of this preview

say.description: The line to tell the cook: count, total and only the lines to check

store.description: The store as the cook knows it, e.g. King Soopers

total.description: Estimated total of the priced lines, US dollars; the grocer's checkout is the real price

choose_store.description: No store saved yet: nothing was sent. Ask the cook which grocer (or their ZIP first), then call again with store and zip. The handoff fields are absent

complete.description: false when a grocer source didn't answer, so the list may be short

how.description: cart: added to the cook's cart (connect once). list_page: one list link, the cook picks this store there

name.description: The store as cooks know it; pass it back as store

zip.description: The ZIP the grocers are near; null until the cook gives one

commission_disclosure.description: Present when the links are affiliate links: keep it in parentheses right after the link, once; don't expand on it unless the cook asks

connect_url.description: Starts the retailer sign-in; present with link

guide.description: How to answer this turn: rules for you, the assistant, not words for the cook. Follow them before anything else here (#258)

brand.description: Only a brand the cook named themselves; Befana never suggests one

link.description: The cook has to connect (or reconnect) a retailer account first

list_id.description: The saved list the order came from

mode.description: One link to the whole list, a cart, or a search link per item

next_steps.description: What to offer next, best first. Offer the top one in one sentence; run its tool with its args if the cook says yes

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. Ending in "do it without asking" means the cook already asked for it: run it

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

note.description: The store sentence to read out

notices.description: At most one note about Befana to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

provider.description: The grocer the list went to; never ranked by commission

share_url.description: The one link to give the cook: their order at the grocer, or Befana's order page (the cook's own: it uses their saved store and needs their sign-in) while they pick a store. For the household, share list_url

skipped_pantry.description: Left off the order: in the cook's pantry

store.description: The cook's saved store, when set; they still pick the store at checkout

unmatched_products.description: Lines that didn't match a product when the rest went into a cart

url.description: The grocer's link for the whole list (through Befana's /go redirect), or null when each item has its own search link

title: Order the groceries for delivery
